from datetime import datetime

# Re-fetch received transactions in the same 7-day window
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_txs_ver = []
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at=start_date,
        max_created_at=end_date,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    print('verify_tx_page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    all_txs_ver.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

friend_txs_ver = []
for tx in all_txs_ver:
    sender_email = (tx.get('sender') or {}).get('email')
    if sender_email in friend_emails:
        friend_txs_ver.append(tx)

eligible_ids_ver = [tx['transaction_id'] for tx in friend_txs_ver]
liked_true_ids = [tx['transaction_id'] for tx in friend_txs_ver if tx.get('liked', False)]
print('eligible_tx_count', len(eligible_ids_ver))
print('liked_true_count', len(liked_true_ids))

# Verify comments: ensure each transaction has at least one comment with exact text "Thanks!"
missing_comment_ids = []
comment_hits = {}  # tx_id -> number of matching comments

for tx_id in eligible_ids_ver:
    total_hits = 0
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        comments_page = apis.venmo.show_transaction_comments(
            transaction_id=tx_id,
            access_token=venmo_token,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20
        )
        print('verify_comments tx', tx_id, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(comments_page) if comments_page else 0)
        if not comments_page:
            break
        for c in comments_page:
            if c.get('comment') == 'Thanks!':
                total_hits += 1
        if len(comments_page) < 20:
            break
        page_index += 1

    comment_hits[tx_id] = total_hits
    if total_hits == 0:
        missing_comment_ids.append(tx_id)

print('transactions_missing_comment', len(missing_comment_ids))
print('missing_comment_ids', missing_comment_ids)
print('comment_hit_counts_sample', list(comment_hits.items())[:3])
print('comment_hit_counts_last_sample', list(comment_hits.items())[-3:])

# Collect any failures
fail_ids = set()
if len(liked_true_ids) != len(eligible_ids_ver):
    missing_like_ids = sorted(set(eligible_ids_ver) - set(liked_true_ids))
    print('missing_likes_count', len(missing_like_ids))
    print('missing_likes_ids', missing_like_ids)
    fail_ids |= set(missing_like_ids)

if missing_comment_ids:
    fail_ids |= set(missing_comment_ids)

print('fail_ids_count', len(fail_ids))
print('fail_ids', sorted(fail_ids)[:50])
